data.description: Spacious 2BR | Unfurnished | Park & JBR View | Delphine Tower
data.display_address: Delphine, Marina Promenade, Dubai Marina, Dubai
data.long_description:
Provident Real Estate is proud to offer this spacious 2-bedroom apartment in Delphine Tower, Marina Promenade, Dubai Marina.

This well-designed apartment features a bright and spacious layout with a closed kitchen, generous living and dining area, walk-in closet, and stunning community views overlooking the park, JBR, and Dubai Marina surroundings. The master bedroom includes an en-suite bathroom with both a bathtub and separate shower, providing additional comfort and convenience.

Property Features:

• 2 Bedrooms
• 3 Bathrooms
• Unfurnished
• Walk-In Closet
• Closed Kitchen
• Bathtub and Separate Shower
• Spacious Living and Dining Area
• Built-In Wardrobes
• Floor-to-Ceiling Windows
• Park and JBR Views
• Covered Parking
• Vacant

Community Features:

• Swimming Pool
• Fully Equipped Gymnasium
• Squash and Badminton Courts
• Children’s Play Area
• BBQ Area
• Landscaped Gardens
• 24/7 Security and Concierge Services
• Direct Access to Marina Walk
• Pet-Friendly Community

Developed by Emaar, Marina Promenade is one of the most established and desirable waterfront communities in Dubai Marina. Residents enjoy a vibrant lifestyle with easy access to Marina Walk, JBR Beach, Bluewaters Island, supermarkets, cafés, restaurants, pharmacies, and public transport, including Dubai Marina Metro and Tram stations.

This property is ideal for end-users and families seeking a spacious home in a prime Marina location with excellent connectivity and lifestyle amenities.
